subject: Important Update: Upcoming Website Maintenance
body: Dear valued customers, we would like to inform you that our website will undergo scheduled maintenance on Saturday, 15th May from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM (UTC). During this time, the website may experience temporary downtime. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any urgent inquiries, please feel free to contact our customer support team.
